Adding infra perspective: after reviewing the transcript and the takeaways, my recommendation is NO HIRE for this cycle. Rationale:
- Skills mismatch for our immediate priorities (storage migration + heavy kv-cache ops). Candidate strong in compute/infra automation, weak on large-scale stateful systems.
- Pushing band for a skillset mismatch sets an unwanted precedent; we have two other high-priority reqs where candidates match the band profile more closely.
- We also have capacity to staff this role later once we refine the scope (Req-18 was broadened during hiring).

If committee agrees, recommend formal closeout and candidate feedback (courteous, specific) and pause the req to re-write scope for Q3.
